questions.question: Which technology is expected to have the biggest impact on automating jobs in the next decade?
By 2030, what percentage of the workforce is predicted to work remotely at least part of the time?
Which type of skill will be most in demand as automation increases?
What trend is leading companies to hire workers from anywhere in the world?
What is the concept of a 'gig economy'?
options: People working for one company their whole lives
Short-term, flexible jobs often coordinated through digital platforms
questions.answer: Short-term, flexible jobs often coordinated through digital platforms

questions.question: Which industry is predicted to see the greatest job growth due to an aging population?
What is 'upskilling' in the workplace?
options: Moving to a higher office floor
Learning new skills to stay relevant as technology changes
Earning more money for the same job
questions.answer: Learning new skills to stay relevant as technology changes

questions.question: Which country has already experimented with a 4-day workweek to improve productivity and wellbeing?
What is one potential risk of increased workplace automation?
options: Employees will have too much vacation time
Mass job displacement in certain industries
questions.answer: Mass job displacement in certain industries
